snippet.title: Ritus Exorcismus Trailer
snippet.description:
Ritus Exorcismus is a story driven horror game where you assume the role of an Exorcist helping fight a surge in demonic possessions.

It has a 2D pixel art style, set in medieval times. It's a blend of topdown exploration with first person encounters.

The demo is available on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/3691430/Ritus_Exorcismus/
